title: Aerated Malt Middle-eastern Bread Fatteh
description: A crispy and airy bread dish loaded with malty flavors and sweet Thai basil notes, perfect for a show-stopping middle-eastern meal.
instructions: Cut the middle eastern bread into 1-inch cubes.
Mix together the unsalted butter, granulated sugar, and salt in a bowl.
Add the eggs, one at a time, to the bowl, mixing until just combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour, whole wheat flour, and instant dry yeast.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Gently fold in the Thai sweet basil horapa.
Pour the mixture into a greased loaf pan and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Bake the loaf for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the loaf from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Cut the loaf into slices and fry them in a pan of oil until crispy and golden brown.
Drizzle with sesame seeds and serve warm.
